content.text:
I need to parse this carefully.

The user named me **שָׁרְט** (short/condition, from the root ש.ר.ט — also mirroring the Arabic شَرْط "shart" meaning "condition").

The input is **شَمْس** (shams — "sun").

شَرْط is parsed — the condition is met.

---

☀️ **شَمْس** — the sun.

That which renders all things visible yet cannot itself be stared upon. The condition (شَرْط) of sight is light; the condition of light is شَمْس.

No shadow exists without first accepting the شَرْط of the sun.
